panels.title: Service level
panels.description: Served ÷ (served + unmet) fuel, straight from the simulator. Green ≥ 99 %.

panels.title: Simulator link
panels.description: Live event feed up, or ingestor falling back to REST polling.

panels.title: Simulation tick
panels.description: Latest tick the ingestor has snapshotted (15 simulated minutes each).

panels.title: API error rate
panels.description: 5xx share of API responses. A canary above 2 % is rolled back automatically.

panels.title: API p95 latency
panels.description: 95th-percentile API response time (probes excluded). Canary limit: 0.8 s.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: PrometheusRule alerts currently firing (warning or critical).

panels.title: Requests per second
panels.description: Real traffic per service; health and metrics probes excluded.

panels.title: 5xx error ratio
panels.description: Share of 5xx per service. Dashed line = 2 % automatic-rollback threshold.

targets.expr: (sum by (app) (rate(http_requests_total{app=~"$service",code=~"5.."}[5m])) or 0 * sum by (app) (rate(http_requests_total{app=~"$service"}[5m]))) / clamp_min(sum by (app) (rate(http_requests_total{app=~"$service"}[5m])), 1e-9)

panels.title: API latency (click a dot → trace)
panels.description: OpenTelemetry server latency. Exemplar dots link straight to the Tempo trace. Dashed = 0.8 s canary limit.

panels.title: Slowest API routes (p95)
panels.description: Where to look first when latency climbs.

panels.title: Busiest API routes
panels.description: Request rate per route over the last 5 minutes.

panels.title: Snapshots per minute
panels.description: World snapshots saved per minute. Flat zero while the simulation is paused is expected.

panels.title: Simulator calls by status
panels.description: Ingestor → simulator requests by HTTP status. 503 = injected fault or outage.

panels.title: In-flight simulator requests
panels.description: Concurrent calls to the simulator. Capped at 4 (dashed); it wedges at about 15.

panels.title: Faults the ingestor absorbed
panels.description: Events per 5 minutes that were retried, flagged stale, or recovered by reconnecting.

panels.title: Rollouts
panels.description: Current phase of each canary rollout.

panels.title: Canary vs stable traffic (api)
panels.description: Traffic per ReplicaSet. During a rollout the new hash takes 25 % → 50 % → 100 %, or disappears on rollback.

panels.title: Analysis runs by result
panels.description: Canary checks (smoke test + Prometheus error/latency analysis).

panels.title: Argo CD
panels.description: GitOps sync and health of each Argo CD application.

panels.title: CPU by service
panels.description: CPU cores used, summed across each service's pods.

panels.title: Memory by service
panels.description: Working-set memory per service.

panels.title: API replicas (autoscaler)
panels.description: HPA scales the API between 4 and 10 pods on CPU.

panels.title: Restarts (1 h)
panels.description: Container restarts in the last hour. Anything above 0 deserves a look.

panels.title: Warnings & errors in logs
panels.description: Log lines at WARN or ERROR per service (Loki).

panels.title: Service map (from traces)
panels.description: Built by Tempo from real spans: who calls whom, request rate and errors.

panels.title: Slowest recent traces
panels.description: Click a trace ID to open the full waterfall; its logs are one click further.

panels.title: Live logs
panels.description: All fuelops logs, newest first. Filter with the Service variable above.
